notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Eternal Witness and Palinchron.
When Eternal Witness and Palinchron enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
If you control seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Palinchron.
